title: Repricing lag
description: How long this venue takes to react to a sharp BTC move. After a move the venue is watched for its first reprice, and the delay is the lag.

state.label: Lag state
state.description: Current when the venue has caught up with spot, lagging while it has not. A lagging venue is briefly mispriced.

repricing_lag_ms.label: Repricing lag
repricing_lag_ms.description: How long the venue took to reprice after the last sharp spot move. Longer means a wider window to trade the stale price.
